Definition: from G1 (as a negative particle) and G4859; inharmonious (figuratively):--agree not.
BiblicalUsage: After Paul quoted Isaiah to the Jews in Rome, they departed and disagreed among themselves, and the word means out of tune with one another. It is the only place it appears.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the word of God still divides hearers the same way, and the disagreement is not with Paul but with the message itself.
